# IRunner.IsKnockedOut property

Knocked out in the current round: thrown up and falling, out of the race, until the camera eliminates it as it leaves the view (KnockedOut). Spikes, saws and lasers knock runners out in a ranked match or with the Lethal Spikes modifier, and [`KnockOut`](./KnockOut.md) in any match.
